title: Activation.
bodyText:
No alarm system shall be activated intentionally except to:

(1) Report an unauthorized intrusion or the commission of an unlawful act;

(2) Test an installed system with the prior knowledge and consent of the police; or

(3) Permit an alarm business to demonstrate a system to a prospective buyer or user.
bodyHtml:
§436M-8  Activation.  No alarm system shall be activated intentionally except to:

     (1)  Report an unauthorized intrusion or the commission of an unlawful act;

     (2)  Test an installed system with the prior knowledge and consent of the police; or

     (3)  Permit an alarm business to demonstrate a system to a prospective buyer or user. [L 1986, c 134, pt of §1; am L 2021, c 230, §9]
